StudentProfile.description: Activated student account linked 1:1 with Firebase Auth UID.

fields.isEligible: boolean (authoritative EC voter clearance, defaults false)

AdminProfile.description: Electoral Commission / Domain Administrator record aligned with Auth custom claims.
